title: 第三四五章 金丹圆满第三四四章 第二个计划
slug: 废灵根修炼慢但我长生不死啊
lines: 灵台山。
李水生在洞府中修炼了一番万锻真元功。
“这次又有进步，足足撑住了一百二十一锤，不错！”
修炼完毕，他再次来到松树下，调养恢复神魂。
不过一月过去，傲天鹰到来，带着一个封印住的储物袋。
“主人，这是祖师托我带来的。”
“其中有着诸位元婴道君积攒的灵石。”
李水生伸手接过，其中不仅有着数亿灵石，还有着一朵天花。
是用不老道君的神魂炼的，还是不朽道君的神魂炼的？
应该是不朽道君的吧。
不朽道君的神魂要强一些。
他清点了一番灵石，合共六亿八千万。
庞大的数量，直接堆满了整个储物袋。
他收下储物袋，将这些灵石都存放在自己的无缺命星之上。
傲天鹰正欲退下，李水生忽然招手，“傲天鹰，你那九房妻妾，都是人族对吧？”
傲天鹰有些不解，“主人，是多了些吗？”
李水生笑笑，“金丹真君，九房妻妾而已，并不算多。”
“可以好生培养一下你的那些半妖子女，以我的名义，挑选几个天赋好的，送去神符门吧。”
“享真传待遇。”
傲天鹰大喜，连忙磕了三个头，“多谢主人！”
他喜滋滋的下山，虽然不知道李水生何意，但总归是好事。
李水生看着傲天鹰离去的背影，“此妖归属于我之后，也算是忠心任事，给他一个好结果吧。”
他回到山洞，服下一颗醒神丹，蕴养神魂。
调整了三月时间，终于是将自身状态调整到最合适之时。
他张开手，拿起天花，一口吞服下去。
天花入腹，李水生瞬间感受到自己的神魂茁壮成长起来。
他不断吸收着天花中的神识，壮大自身神魂。
因为他本就神魂化形，神魂境界极高，这一次吸收极为顺利。
不过花了三月时间，李水生三花聚顶，登临金丹圆满之境！
李水生仔细感受了一番自己如今的神魂，“不愧是金丹圆满之境，我如今的神魂，足足壮大了七八倍不止！”
“不朽道君的神魂真棒，不过现在，是我的模样了。”
他再次尝试练习万锻真元法，这一次果然好了许多。
“一千一百八十二锤！”
“元婴可期啊！”
玄冥历八百六十年。
玄天道君寿尽，天奇冲击元婴，被叶辰所察觉。
叶辰前去寻仇，玉清道君不许。
玉清道君亲自出手，却遭人族五大元婴围剿，玉清道君身死，其阴金净土太虚剑域现世。
元婴混战之下，玉清仙门与玄天仙门遭受重大破坏。
玄天道君的元婴传承于混战中失踪，不知去向。
玄冥历八百六十一年，陆痴以太虚剑域为道基，服地花晋升金丹后期。
content_en:
Lingtai Mountain.
Li Shuisheng practiced the Ten Thousand Refinement True Yuan Gong in the cave.
"There is progress again this time. It can withstand a hundred and twenty-one hammers. Not bad!"
After practicing, he came to the pine tree again to recuperate and restore his soul.
But one month passed, and Proud Eagle arrived, bringing with him a sealed storage bag.
"Master, the ancestor asked me to bring this."
"It contains the spiritual stones accumulated by all Nascent Soul Dao Lords."
Li Shuisheng reached out and took it. Not only did it contain hundreds of millions of spiritual stones, but it also contained a smallpox.
Was it made with the soul of the immortal Taoist or the soul of the immortal Taoist?
It should belong to the Immortal Dao Lord.
The soul of the Immortal Dao Lord is stronger.
He counted the spiritual stones and found a total of 680 million.
The huge quantity filled the entire storage bag.
He took away the storage bag and stored these spiritual stones on his perfect life star.
Ao Tianying was about to retreat when Li Shuisheng suddenly waved, "Ao Tianying, your nine wives and concubines are all human race, right?"
Ao Tianying was a little puzzled, "Master, is there too much?"
Li Shuisheng smiled and said, "Jin Dan Zhenjun only has nine wives and concubines, which is not too much."
"You can train your half-demon children properly. In my name, select a few with good talents and send them to the Talisman Sect."
"Enjoy the true treatment."
Ao Tianying was overjoyed and kowtowed three times, "Thank you, Master!"
He went down the mountain happily. Although he didn't know what Li Shuisheng meant, it was always a good thing.
Li Shuisheng looked at Ao Tianying's leaving figure and said, "After this demon belongs to me, I can be regarded as serving him loyally. Let's give him a good result."
He returned to the cave and took an awakening pill to nourish his soul.
After adjusting the time in March, it was finally time to adjust my condition to the most suitable one.
He opened his hand, picked up the smallpox, and swallowed it in one gulp.
Smallpox entered his stomach, and Li Shuisheng instantly felt his soul growing vigorously.
He continued to absorb the divine consciousness in the smallpox and strengthen his own soul.
Because he had already transformed into a divine soul, and his divine soul state was extremely high, the absorption was extremely smooth this time.
However, it took three months for Li Shuisheng to gather the three flowers at the top and reach the state of perfect golden elixir!
Li Shuisheng carefully felt his current soul, "It is worthy of the perfection of the golden elixir. My current soul is more than seven or eight times stronger!"
"The soul of the Immortal Dao Lord is awesome, but now, it looks like me."
He tried practicing the Ten Thousand Refinement True Essence Method again, and this time it turned out to be much better.
"One thousand one hundred and eighty-two hammers!"
"Nascent Soul can be expected!"
Xuan Ming calendar eight hundred and sixty years.
When Xuantian Daojun expired, Tianqi attacked Nascent Soul and was noticed by Ye Chen.
Ye Chen went to seek revenge, but Taoist Yuqing refused.
Daojun Yuqing personally took action, but was surrounded and suppressed by the five great Nascent Souls of the human race. Daojun Yuqing died, and his Yinjin Pure Land Taixu Sword Domain appeared.
In the melee between Nascent Soul, Yuqing Immortal Sect and Xuantian Immortal Sect suffered heavy damage.
Daojun Xuantian's Nascent Soul inheritance disappeared in the melee and disappeared.
In the 861st year of Xuan Ming Calendar, Lu Chi took the Taixu Sword Domain as his Taoist foundation, and was promoted to the late stage of Jindan by obeying Dihua.
